author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Gameplay Trailer for Die to Play, a dice-based deckbuilder developed by Kvinter Games. Players will man an ancient retro computer with a cursed game on its hard drive. Customize decks, reveal story fragments over time, and reign victorious in turn-based encounters. Die to Play is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Die to Play - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Tied to the Beat, a 2D survival bullet hell action roguelike developed by Javier Lianes Garcia. Players will fight enemies to the beats and melodies of their own playlist. Import songs, choose a weapon, and survive enemies that swarm to the lyrics. Tied to the Beat is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC (Steam).
title: Tied to the Beat - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Feed the Queen, a strategic colony simulation game developed by Quiétude. Players will seek out food to continue the colony's growth. Make new synergies, create specialized workers, and feed the queen above all else. Feed the Queen is launching on May 25 for PC (Steam).
title: Feed the Queen - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Announcement Trailer for Taival, a co-op adventure RPG developed by Poysky Productions. Players will explore a lively and bustling world alone or with friends to embark on narrative quests, overcome challenges, and partake in a plethora of wholesome activities. Taival is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a Kickstarter available now to support the game's development. 

Support the game on Kickstarter here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/poysky-productions/taival
title: Taival - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Playtest Announcement Trailer for Planted!, a multiplayer party game developed by Cloth Cat Games. Players will fight within the confines of gardens to grow the ammunition used in combat. Tend to the harvest, steal others' fertilizer, and attain power-ups in the process. Planted! is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam), with a Playtest running from May 25 through June 1.
title: Planted! - Official Playtest Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Galactic Disharmony, a sci-fi first-person action strategy shooter developed by Harrison Went. Players will assert their forces across the galaxy through battle engagements. Secure resources, explore a suite of different modes from Story to Battle modes, and conquer planets in the name of humanity. Galactic Disharmony is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Galactic Disharmony - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Co-Op Reveal Trailer for Deadhaus Sonata, an upcoming third-person narrative-driven action RPG developed by Apocalypse Studios. Players will take on the most daunting of challenges with friends in 6-player co-op mode. Combine abilities, coordinate attacks, and take on enemy forces together. Deadhaus Sonata is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Deadhaus Sonata - Official Co-Op Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Sokka Developer Overview for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game (working title), an upcoming 2D anime action fighting game based on the hit Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. 
Players can get the rundown on one of Team Avatar's finest with Sokka stepping into the fight. Hear straight from Geoff Mendicino on core techniques, weapons, and sneaky skills that define the master of disaster that is Sokka. Make use of boomerangs, strategy, and a bit of chaos as Sokka in Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, launching on July 2 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with an eventual release on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.

Preorder on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424420/Avatar_Legends_The_Fighting_Game/

Wishlist on PS5: 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018989/

Wishlist on Xbox Series X|S: 
https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store
title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game - Official Sokka Developer Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for TwentyOne, a story-driven psychological card game developed by StuckArcader. Players will set out as Gambit in a corrupted city to engage in illegal gambling to make ends meet. Follow the questionable rules, perform under the pressure of the neon lights, and save a family that hangs in the balance. TwentyOne is available now for PC (Steam).
title: TwentyOne - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for Cliff Kingdom, a 2D exploration Metroidvania souls-like developed by Most Likely No Reason For Hysteria. Players will rise as the lone member of a long line of other lightkeepers named Mothboy after the coveted lighthouse goes dark. Climb, explore, and fight through enemies to find the lost light. Cliff Kingdom is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Cliff Kingdom - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark, a compilation of hit action arcade shoot 'em up games developed by M2 Co. Players will gain access to a suite of classic titles, including Flying Shark, Sky Shark, Fire Shark, and more, with multiplayer support and international versions. Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark is launching on August 29 for PlayStation 4 (PS4) and Nintendo Switch.
title: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for World of Magic: Rise of Magic, an upcoming open-world medieval punk action RPG developed by Ice Dragons. Players will explore a packed world full of activities to experience across a dense narrative. Set out into a world where magic and technology collide to overcome combat encounters, make dialogue choices, and progress with new spells and abilities. World of Magic: Rise of Magic is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: World of Magic: Rise of Magic - Official Gameplay Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, a roguelite RTS developed by Alt Shift. Players will prepare the fleet to embark on a dangerous mission to evade the Cylon Fleet and rejoin the Battlestar Galactica for salvation. Allocate supplies, attain ship upgrades, and train the crew in Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, available now for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a look at the 'At the Wake of Spring' Update Overview Trailer for Arknights: Endfield, an anime action RPG developed by Hypergryph. Players can get a look at new updates and features with the upcoming update, including a new Test Area, new Events and Activities, and more to explore. The 'At the Wake of Spring' Update is available now for Arknights: Endfield on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (Steam).
title: Arknights: Endfield - Official 'At the Wake of Spring' Update Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Evanescia Character Trailer for Honkai: Star Rail, the hit strategy RPG developed by HoYoverse. Players can become acquainted with Evanescia, a new hero making her mark on the game with her blade of roses and quick strikes. Evanescia for Honkai: Star Rail is launching on May 13 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC (HoYoPlay and Epic Games Store).
title: Honkai: Star Rail - Official Evanescia Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Daytona Supercross Track Pack Launch Trailer for MX vs ATV Legends, an action off-road racing game developed by Rainbow Studios. Players will gain access to new content with the new pack that brings iconic moments in Supercross with the Daytona Supercross Track to the game across two phases. The Daytona Supercross Track Pack is available now for MX vs ATV Legends on PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: MX vs ATV Legends - Official Daytona Supercross Track Pack Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Iron Bramble, a 2D action Metroidvania developed by Mini Bunnies and Emlise. Players will explore a cyber-gothic megastructure by way of an elastic grappling hook, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead atone for their sins. Engage with the game's momentum-based movement, overcome platforming challenges, and dispatch enemies through a suite of enemies. Iron Bramble is launching in 2027 for PC (Steam).
title: Iron Bramble - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: In the second episode of this series of videos from the developers, Narrative and Creative Director Emanuele talks about how the narrative asks players to step into a very uncomfortable place. The idea is to explore feelings of anger, rejection, and frustration of a man who is forced to perform a ritual to protect his family. The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline will be available on PC in 2026, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline - Official Official Devlog Video 2

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Reveal Trailer for Bring It, a retro arcade motorcycle delivery game developed by Team Machiavelli. Players must stay focused amongst the chaos to drift, jump, and pull off tricks to deliver packages. Maximize the score in Bring It, coming soon to PlayStation and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Bring It - Official Reveal Trailer
